review.notes: Chain starts at v0 (FET-EN008, 2005-03-01), the text the GOAT variant carries exactly. The lineage's apparent trigger rewording, v2 'If this card successfully attacks your opponent directly' -> v3/v4 'inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent by a direct attack', is not implemented as a difference by upstream: both the GOAT and the modern script register the LV-up flag from EVENT_BATTLE_DAMAGE with ep~=tp and Duel.GetAttackTarget()==nil, so it is treated as cosmetic here; likewise 'unaffected by your opponent's Spell Cards' -> 'Spell effects' (the immunity filter differs only as te:IsActiveType(TYPE_SPELL) vs te:IsSpellEffect(), upstream idiom), and the flag-effect reset constants are the same value spelled out. Flagged chronology-unresolved because the script encodes both era components and only the reveal is dated: neither the 2005-06-16 UDE capture nor the 2008-12-15 Card FAQ capture carries a verification or activation ruling for this card, so the end date of the relaxed activation condition is unattested.

effective.basis: Old state: UDE official card rulings (Sangan/Witch: 'If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify', captured 2005-06-16) through Konami's own per-set rulings documents - Machina Mayhem (2010-04-06, 18 days before the Edison snapshot), Starstrike Blast (2010-11-16), Storm of Ragnarok (2011-02-02). New state: KDE-US Tournament Policy section 'Card/Hand/Deck Verification' forbids verifying the opponent's Deck (first located capture 2019-04-03; still current in v2.5, 2025-09-05). No dated announcement of the change was found, so the interval 2011-02-02 .. 2019-04-03 stays open.

corroboration.title: UDE official Yu-Gi-Oh! Card Rulings (capture 2005-06-16, inside the GOAT window)
corroboration.quote: You must show your opponent the monster you select from your Deck for this card's effect. If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify.

corroboration.title: Konami, Machina Mayhem Structure Deck Card Rulings, compiled April 6th 2010 (18 days before the Edison snapshot)
corroboration.quote: If you do not have "Commander Covington" in your Deck, your opponent can ask to verify.

corroboration.title: Konami, Storm of Ragnarok Card Rulings, compiled February 2 2011 - the latest positive attestation of the old state
corroboration.quote: If there is no longer a monster in your hand that you can Special Summon when this effect resolves, your opponent may briefly verify that this is the case.

event.historical_text: This card is unaffected by your opponent's Spell Cards. If this card successfully attacks your opponent's Life Points directly, during your next Standby Phase, send this face-up card to the Graveyard to Special Summon 1 "Silent Swordsman LV7" from your hand or Deck.
event.summary: Period procedure plus a relaxed activation condition, not a text erratum: the GOAT script reduces s.sptg's check to `ft>0 and true` (the modern Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard over hand+Deck is removed), so the Standby Phase effect can be activated after a direct attack with no "Silent Swordsman LV7" in hand or Deck, and the failure is proven by revealing hand and Deck (Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_DECK)); the modern script requires an available LV7 and never reveals.
